name: True Casting
body:
School divination; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round or until discharged

DESCRIPTION

Your next single spell (if it is cast before the end of the next round) gains a +10 insight bonus on any caster level checks to overcome spell resistance or cast defensively.
